Name: Clover Grass - Unofficial 1.6 Update
Author: Syllo00
Description:
[color=#6d9eeb][b][size=4]Not my own creation, I just altered the sprites and added new ones from the original from itsanette.[/size][/b][/color]

I made/revised some assets for clover grass from the original mod ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15033]here[/url]﻿) for the new blue grass in the 1.6 update because I couldn't live without it, :).


[u]Compatibilities:
[/u]- It should be compatible with Daisy Niko's Earthy Recolor and Vibrant Pastoral Recolor.


[u][size=3]Installation Instructions:
[/size][/u]- Just download and extract into your mod folder.
- Make sure to delete the old original mod before downloading.

Downloads.Description: Now includes Starblue thanks to NARCOAZAZAL :)
